verdicts.reason: A: the tree logo has come loose from the frame and sits above the dark band on the busy, blurry sawdust image. The title is tiny for a 768 square, so the lockup reads as a small afterthought in a cramped box. B: the logo and title stay together inside the frame at a strong, readable size, so the hierarchy holds. However, the frame overshoots the dark band at the top and bottom, so its edges sit over the busy image and don't line up with the band. Both versions use an over-zoomed, soft crop of the photo.
